title: Loops
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Loops in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: for loop
items.text: A for loop repeats over the items of an iterable such as a list, string or range.

items.heading: while loop
items.text: A while loop repeats while its condition remains true.

items.heading: range()
items.text: range() is commonly used to produce a sequence of numbers for loops. range(3) represents 0, 1 and 2.

items.heading: break
items.text: break immediately leaves the nearest loop.

items.heading: continue
items.text: continue skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next iteration.

items.heading: Iterable
items.text: An iterable is an object whose values can be visited one by one, such as a list, tuple or string.

items.heading: Loop counting
items.text: for with range() is useful when a task needs to repeat a known number of times.

items.heading: Infinite while loops
items.text: A while loop can continue forever if its condition never becomes false. Update the state toward a stopping condition.

items.heading: Nested loops
items.text: A loop can contain another loop. The inner loop completes its iterations for each outer-loop iteration.

items.heading: Choosing a loop
items.text: Use for when iterating through an iterable is natural; use while when repetition depends mainly on a condition.
